sn55.12:1.7: Unsurprisingly for a practice with such high mortality rates, this is not attested in Brahmanical texts. Perhaps it is a misunderstood version of the worship of sun and moon in their course in the sky (see note on [dn13:16.2]()). Or perhaps it started as a healing medicine, with the wish for the patient to rise and go on with their life (cf. Atharva Veda 5.30.7).
